Gloria Verde Resort

Belek, Antalya, Turkey
Ultra All Inclusive Pine Forest Setting Shared Golf Estate

About Gloria Verde Resort

Gloria Verde Resort sits within a 50-hectare pine forest right on the coast, connected to the wider Gloria estate by a 2.7 km path that runs through one of its golf courses.

The hotel is part of a 220-hectare recreation area shared with its sister property, Gloria Golf Resort, so guests get access to multiple courses and facilities across the estate without leaving the grounds.

Gallery

Hotel Features

  • Ultra All Inclusive board basis
  • Set in 50 ha of coastal pine forest
  • Shared access to the wider Gloria golf estate
  • Direct beach access
  • Multiple pools and aqua park
  • Spa and wellness centre
  • Kids' club and family facilities
  • On-site golf academy

Golf Course Notes

Guests can play across the Gloria estate's courses, reached via a scenic path through the pine forest rather than a shuttle transfer.
